[ZulGurub] [Hakkar] Pending Restarts: Doubled the time between Son of Hakkar spawns.
[ZulGurub] [Hakkar] Pending Restarts: Doubled the time between Corrupted Blood Puddle spawns.

0.description: Fixed an issue where characters after prestiging would have their character sometimes locked.
Added 25 Marks of Ascension to every dungeon boss in Vanilla.
Added 100 Marks of Ascension to every raid boss.
Fixed an issue where players would get double loading screens when zoning into our new maps.
Implementing additional performance improvements to keep up with growing population.
Optimized Titan Scroll Performance.
Increased visibility distance even more!
Fixed item caching bug.
[Alar] Added Quest Givers to start zones that offer Tank based skillcards.
[Alar] The base drop chance for High-Risk Materials has been significantly increased. The bonus For the Horde/Alliance! drop chance has also been significantly increased.
The Duration of the Arcane Dexterity enchant now lasts for 8 seconds.

5.description: [Alar] Cooking Suppliers will now offer Soothing Spices used in High-Risk cooking recipes.
[Alar] Fixed incorrect ingredient costs for High-Risk Gnomish Masterkey. They now require the same material counts as High-Risk Homicite Keys. (Requires patch to see updated values in-game)

0.description: Fixed Minimaps and maps in start zones and capital cities.
The Great Sea can no longer become a hotspot lol.
[Alar] (Pending Restart) Fixed an issue with Hidden Cache loot. Rare and Epic keys always drop ZG loot now.
Increased dynamic respawn rates for mobs.

Fixed an issue where tooltips would not display their cooldown reduction in the tooltip or actionbars and would come off cooldown when the cooldown of the spell matched your cooldown reduction for said spell. It will properly tick down with cooldown reduction.
Fixed stopcasting functions. Pressing escape or a macro with the /stopcasting command will now properly (and not just visually) stop ongoing spell casts.
Drastically increased the performance of the auction house.
Fixed the fluidity and responsiveness of certain ability & functionalities with GCD & CDs. Example: Execute & Overpower would not light up when useable at certain times.
Increased visiblity range in the Open World.

Fixed an issue where talents or mystic enchantments that would reset the cooldown of abilities would not properly show their cooldown. Examples: Lock & Load with explosive shot would show the ability had no global cooldown, but would not let you cast it until the global cooldown was expended.
Updated the responsiveness of the global cooldown - sometimes failing to casting an ability even though the cooldown showed as if the spell was ready to be cast.
Fixed an issue where spells that modified the cast time of the spells would also not reduce the global cool down, examples: Decimation & Backdraft.

Fixed an issue where Auto Shot with the Hawk Eye talent would not allow you to start shooting at more than 35 yard range and require you to start at 35 yard range, allowing you to back up to 41 yard range while not cancelling your Auto Shot.
Fixed an issue where certain random enchantments such as: Perilous Pain & Scorched Earth would not have their range increased by talents like destructive reach & flame throwing.

Tooltip Correctors should now show updated damage - I.e. if you have divine storm, then pick up the art of war talent, your divine storm damage will show the damage dealt correctly. This applies to all talents & abilities.
Luck of the Draw will grant 15% bonus to health, damage, and healing up from 10%. Luck of the Draw is a buff granted to a party finding random party members using the random dungeon que.

Fixed an issue where you could not have multiple items of the unique - equipped quality. This is fixed with a patch update. Your client will experience a crash if you do not have the latest patch from the launcher and obtain more than one of these items.

Overhauled our Tooltip Modification System. This is a systemic change that will fix things like Overpower, Revenge, Execute, Range modifiers on spells, Cooldowns not ticking down properly, and much more! You'll need the patch from the launcher for this one.

6.description: [ZulGurub] [High Priestess Jeklik] Corrected an issue where Frenzied Bat Riders would spawn on Flex Mode difficulties.
[ZulGurub]  The following bosses have seen greater reworks, including Ascended mechanics. Jeklik, Marli, Venoxis, Arlokk, Thekal, Hakkar.

[ZulGurub] [All Bosses] All Bosses within ZulGurub have been been modernised to TBC standards. Bosses will now properly engage and disengage, adjust flex scaling, send additional boss frames and overall have improved AIs.

1.description: Fixed an issue where the final rank of Nature's Reach didn't increase the range of Entangling Roots by the proper amount.

0.description: Prestige will now grant 5 Sealed Cards when you reset to level 1.
Fixed lighting on new start zone maps.
Fixed various missing creatures, gameobjects, and questgivers after mapping update.
Fixed nodes not being pooled in start zones after mapping update.
Put all start zones, Orgrimmar, and Stormwind onto their own maps to improve performance.
[Area 52] Introduced new Mystic Enchant UI.
[Area 52] Updated and Fixes Various Prestige bugs.

1.description: Fixed an issue where the Test of Faith update wasn't properly applied. [Pending restart]
Fixed an issue where some ranks of Typhoon had a targeting circle. [Requires launcher update]
The movement speed increase buff from the Survival Tactics capstone effect now starts after you land.
Improved Gouge is now a 3 point talent, changed from 5. It now reduces the cooldown of Gouge by 1/2/3 sec and increases the duration by 0,33/0,66/1 sec.
Test of Faith Capstone has been reworked. It now reduces spell damage taken by 10% while casting Smite, Holy Fire or any Priest healing spell.
Kidney Shot now has a 40 second cooldown, changed from 45.
Improved Kidney Shot is now a 3 point talent, changed from 5 and reduces the cooldown of Kidney Shot by 5/10/15 sec, changed from 4/8/12/16/20 sec.
Reduced the mana cost of all low-level healing spells by up to 20%.
Survivalist is now a 3 point talent, changed from 5. It now increases the duration of Deterrence by 1/2/3 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 15/30/45 seconds.
The Anger Management capstone now lasts for 4 seconds, up from 3.

Dissolving Shadows is now a three point talent, reducing the cooldown of Dispersion by 20/40/60 seconds (from 12/24/36/48/60) and increasing its damage reduction effect by 5/10/15% (from 6/12/18/24/30%).
Dispersion now reduces damage taken by 80%, up from 60%.
Backdraft now also increases the damage of Shadowburn by 7/14/20%.
Reduced the damage of Shadowburn by 10%.
Improved Blink now reduces the mana cost of Blink by 33/66/100%, up from 10/20/30%.
New Capstone: Benediction - Benediction now also restores mana to party members below 50% of their total mana.
Benediction is now a 3 point talent restoring 7/14/20% of your base mana (from 4/8/12/16/20%) when you kill an enemy that yields experience or honor.
The Clearcasting effect from Elemental Focus now reduces the mana cost of your next two Fire, Nature or Frost spells by 30%, up from 20%.
Arcane Concentration now has a 5/10/15% chance to trigger, up from 4/7/10%.
Master of Elements now restores up to 50% of the base mana cost of the spell, up from 30%.
Illumination now restores up to 60% of the base mana cost of the spell, up from 40%.
Fixed the tooltip of Frozen Power to display the correct range.
